what: The screen is covered by square cells matching the background grid (275px at 1440 width), then opens as each cell turns off over .2s with a random 0~.5s delay. Clicking a same-site link turns the cells on over .1s with a random 0~.25s delay to cover the screen, and navigates .4s later. The first cell row meshes with the page grid lines (up to the scroll position). With an intro panel, that panel shows for 2.5 seconds only on the first open in a tab, then the cells cover (1s) and lift away

options.cell: Cell side (px, relative to base width), default 275 — scales with screen width and adds a 1px line
options.base: Reference width for cell size, default 1440
options.cell-sm: Phone cell side length, default 118 (based on base-sm 375)
options.sm: Width treated as phone (px or less), default 767
options.y: Height of the first horizontal line of the page grid (px, base scale), default 104 — so cells lock onto grid lines
options.y-sm: Phone first horizontal line height, default 50
options.open: Max cell delay on open (sec), default .5
options.fade: Duration for one cell to turn on (sec), default .1
options.out: Duration for one cell to turn off (sec), default .2
options.wait: Time from the start of the cover to calling the next page (seconds), default .4 — 0 turns the page immediately
options.delay: Time from open to start of walking (sec), default .1
options.hold: Seconds to show the panel on first visit, default 2.5
options.cover: Seconds the cells stay covering the panel on first visit, default 1
options.[data-fx-part=intro]: First-visit panel (optional) — logo and photo. Shown only the first time a tab opens, and when parts are ready, is-ready is added to the cover to trigger motion inside the panel
options.fx:phase: Event raised from the cover — detail.phase is ready, cover, hide, open (.6 seconds after it lifts, fx-tv-open on html), or leave. To hide the whole screen before ready as the original does, the consuming side should set a mark on body at ready so that it shows then
options.[data-veil-skip]: Links with this mark (or an ancestor with it) are skipped, not covered
options.ready: Minimum blank time (seconds) before showing the first-visit panel, default .25 — for matching the delay of the original as it loads fonts and images on first open (Brand 1). Panels arriving from elsewhere always use .25

use:
…Logo panel…
— One at the very start of body. Page motion starts at the open phase of fx:phase
note: The original separates first visits by cookie, but the part uses sessionStorage (one tab)
